title.narrative: Enhancing Flood Resilience for Tana River Basin in Kenya

description.narrative: The project seeks to support the Kenyan government efforts in averting future disasters and dealing with the aftermath of the 2024 flood events that affected the country from April continuing till June 2024, using a comprehensive, context specific and people centered approach. The project will generate flood exposure maps and identify flood disaster hotspots, which will be used for policy development and settlements’ planning to avoid such losses in the future. A Flood Early Warning System for Tana River Basin will be developed to provide with alerts the communities and avert such devastating disasters in the future. E-learning material will be developed, and human capacities will be enhanced at technical level. All tools and products will be communicated to the public using consultations, related Apps and through community radios in K-Swahili and local languages. Furthermore, communication with NGOs working in the region will be pursued to extent the reach of the project.
